unit3d_baseline.create_table:
CREATE TABLE `peer_ips` (
  `user_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `torrent_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `peer_id` binary(20) NOT NULL,
  `family` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `ip` varbinary(16) NOT NULL,
  `port` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `connectable` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_announced_at` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `connectivity_checked_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`torrent_id`,`peer_id`,`family`),
  KEY `peer_ips_torrent_family_live` (`torrent_id`,`family`,`last_announced_at`),
  KEY `peer_ips_expiration` (`last_announced_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `peer_ips_user_id_torrent_id_peer_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`, `torrent_id`, `peer_id`) REFERENCES `peers` (`user_id`, `torrent_id`, `peer_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `peer_ips_family_length` CHECK ((((`family` = 4) and (length(`ip`) = 4)) or ((`family` = 6) and (length(`ip`) = 16)))),
  CONSTRAINT `peer_ips_positive_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
